derivation:
SETUP. For sequence length L the scored cells are (sequence, t) for t=1..L-1 over all 2^L sequences, each sequence equally weighted and each scored time equally weighted, so every cell carries weight 1/N with N = 2^L*(L-1) (N=16 for L=3, N=48 for L=4). Boundary convention x_j=0 for j<0 is applied, so at t=1 c=x_{t-2}=0 and at t=0..; time 0 is never scored. The mode bit M is visible to BOTH the next-state table N and the output table O, so a single one-bit machine can run an independent strategy in each mode; likewise a stateless machine has an independent output column per mode. The two modes therefore do not interfere and the objective separates exactly as E(class) = (1-p)*e_0*(class) + p*e_1*(class), which is what T1/T4 assume. Because the distribution of scored windows does not depend on M, e_m*(class) depends only on (target_m, L).

T2 (stateless, computed exactly). A stateless machine sees only (M, x_t), so within a mode its scored cells partition by a=x_t into at most two groups. The cell-wise majority output is optimal and the contribution of a group with n0 target-0 cells and n1 target-1 cells is min(n0,n1); a frequency tie n0=n1 gives exactly half that group in error, which is the '1/2 for that cell' clause of T2. Hence e_m*(STATELESS) = (sum over a-groups of min(n0,n1)) / N. This derivation is a proof, not an approximation: no stateless machine can do better because nothing else is visible to it.

T3 (one-bit, computed as the theory instructs). The theory's designated machine has N(S,M,a)=a, giving S_{t+1}=x_t, i.e. S_t=x_{t-1} for all t>=1 and S_0=0=x_{-1}, consistent with the boundary convention. Its visible cell is therefore (M, x_t, x_{t-1}) and its output table O(S,M,a) is free, so its error is the cell-wise optimum over the four (a,b) groups per mode: e_m*(PERSISTENT_STATE) = (sum over (a,b)-groups of min(n0,n1)) / N. Group tables for every environment and mode are listed below.

MONOTONICITY OF THE POSSIBLE ERROR (important, and it makes the failure predictions one-sided). T2 is exact. The carry machine is a legal member of the one-bit universe, so the true one-bit optimum satisfies e_m*(true) <= e_m*(T3). Therefore true E_onebit <= predicted E_onebit, and true lambda* = eta*(E_stateless - E_onebit) >= predicted lambda*. Consequences, stated as predictions: (i) every PERSISTENT_STATE call in this batch is safe, because lambda < predicted lambda* <= true lambda*; (ii) a predicted tie can only move toward PERSISTENT_STATE, never toward STATELESS; (iii) only STATELESS calls can be refuted, and only at lambdas lying just above the predicted lambda*; (iv) J_best_stateless is exact in every environment, while J_best_onebit is an upper bound that is exact wherever it equals eta*0+lambda (i.e. wherever the one-bit class reaches error 0, an absolute floor).

WHERE I EXPECT T3 TO BE WRONG (target-level reasoning only; no machine was enumerated, simulated or searched). T3 asserts that the optimal one-bit state is a DELAY LINE carrying x_{t-1}. The registered candidate universe is far larger: the state may be any Boolean function of (M, x_0..x_{t-1}) realisable by iterating N, which includes accumulator states (running OR / running AND of the prefix) and boundary latches that partially encode how far the episode has run. For targets that are functions of (a,b) only -- CUR, NOT_CUR, PREV, NOT_PREV, XOR, XNOR, AND, OR, NAND, CONST0, CONST1 -- the delay line makes the target exactly computable, so e_m*=0 is an absolute floor and T3 is provably tight. For targets reaching back to c=x_{t-2} -- PREV2, XOR2, AND2, OR2, MAJ3 -- T3 is unsupported, and for PREV2 it is actively suspicious: PREV2 depends on c alone, and on the interior scored cells x_{t-1} is independent of x_{t-2}, so the delay-line state carries literally zero information about the target there and buys nothing over the stateless optimum (visible below as e_sl = e_1b for PREV2 in both E04 and E10). Any state that instead retains prefix information -- which the universe permits -- can only help. Note also two boundary collapses that a delay line discards: at t=1 the c=0 convention turns MAJ3 into a AND b and turns XOR2 into a, and at L=3 the scored PREV2/OR2 cells are functions of the prefix (x_0, x_0 or x_1) rather than of the recent window.

ABSTENTION. The theory as stated abstains nowhere in this batch: T1-T4 return a definite class set at all 29 tested (environment, lambda) pairs, including the two degenerate controls p=0 (E05) and p=1 (E06), where the unscored mode's error is multiplied by zero and simply drops out. Exactly one tie is predicted (E05/E08/E11 have lambda*=0 but every tested lambda is strictly positive, so they are strict STATELESS wins, not ties).
